name: Music Maestro
description: A large-scale music evaluation benchmark designed to assess large language models' performance on music understanding and generation/evaluation tasks.
evaluation_method: F1 and human_eval (task-specific objective metrics such as onset/pitch F1 for transcription plus human evaluation for generation)
general_score_metric: composite_score (combining task-specific objective metrics and human evaluation)
reputation: A recently introduced, well-cited benchmark within the music-ML community that is gaining traction for evaluating LLMs on music understanding and generation.
notes: Contains multiple task types with heterogeneous metrics; risk of pretraining contamination for popular public music corpora; human evaluation variance for generative tasks can limit reproducibility.
